zh.title: 美國航空因幼童在旅途中滿兩歲強制收取費用
zh.summary: 美國航空要求在旅途中迎來兩歲生日的幼童付費購票；家長面臨意外費用
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，一家人在旅途中面臨來自美國航空（American Airlines）高達 871 美元的意外收費。起因是該家庭的幼童在旅程中途迎來兩歲生日，航空公司隨即推翻了原本的抱膝搭乘免位安排，堅持要求該名幼童必須購買獨立座位。
在這起事件中，由於孩童在旅途中跨越兩歲的年齡界線，美國航空便要求母親支付 871 美元的費用，否則可能無法帶同幼童搭機。航空公司推翻原先的抱嬰免票安排並強制購票，使這家人面臨這筆突如其來的財務支出。

en.title: American Airlines Charges Family $871 After Toddler Turns Two Mid-Trip
en.summary: American Airlines charged a mother $871 after her child turned two years old mid-trip.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, a family was confronted with an unexpected $871 charge from American Airlines during a trip. The situation arose when the airline reversed its lap seating policy for a toddler who turned two years old mid-trip, insisting that a separate seat must be purchased.

In this incident, since the child crossed the age threshold of two years during the journey, American Airlines required the mother to pay the $871 fee, or potentially leave the toddler behind. The airline reversed the previous lap seating arrangement and mandated a purchased seat, causing an unexpected financial surprise.
